study.question: Does buy-context rank35 lose click quality because of limited rank alone, or can a same-initial-product change of factor optimization coordinates preserve the full112 incumbent quality with fewer parameters and measured lower prediction cost?
study.hypothesis: Observation: g2-r0056-joint_energy_full112 click AUC0.6674485580556159 exceeds dense separate0.6672902815744913, raw35 0.6669746715660667 and norm35 0.66682759997943. Frobenius restoration did not rescue this implementation; rank48 earlier reached0.6666401850657749, so the rank response is not monotone. Full112 uses205427 dense Parameters versus182019 for35. Raw35 inference wall varied24.55 to27.44s on identical quality, while p50 was about14.97-15.03ms versus14.96ms full112; neither saved weights nor one fast receipt establishes a speed benefit. Mechanism hypothesis, unverified: distributing singular values differently across factors changes effective update geometry and may recover useful shared-context training at rank35 without increasing rank or nonlinear width. Balanced L=U_r sqrt(S_r), R=sqrt(S_r)V_r and output-heavy L=U_r S_r, R=V_r initialize the same truncated product over real arithmetic. This is a parameterization/optimization contrast, not a new feature interaction method. Counterevidence: g2-r0052-joint_rank_output73 AUC0.6668091428093557 versus balanced73 0.6668143579868517 was nearly null on a different whole-affine factorization; no transfer is presumed. Broader negative trajectories include embedding/scorer reductions, owner tower reduction and context semantic/mixed splitting; they prevent interpreting every smaller model as benign. All trajectories in the supplied index report execution success; these are scientific negative/null outcomes, not execution failures. Latest knowledge usage declared Frobenius normalization and all four round56 modules executed successfully, but no causal confirmation or seed replication followed. Current phase allows only proposal/code; local torch is absent and released parquet/loader execution is inaccessible. Reference receipts establish historical executions, not a new reproduction in this jail.

study.proposed_difference: Add validated owner_context_balance=balanced|output_heavy after all inherited resets and reductions. At a fixed rank, output_heavy moves singular magnitudes into context_output and gives context_input orthonormal rows; no intermediate nonlinearity, forward scalar, RNG draw, cache, file/network I/O or extra Parameter. Keep scale=inherited in every cell; norm restoration is deliberately excluded after its negative observation. Four standalone modules form rank35/112 x balanced/output_heavy. This is a bounded capacity/optimization attribution study; it does not establish a new architecture or a necessary rank.
predictions: At construction, same-rank balanced/output-heavy products match the same fresh W_r within declared FP32 tolerances; full112 matches W. Retained local weights, bias, non-context state and external RNG are unchanged. Output-heavy input rows satisfy R R^T approximately I. Fixed-rank counts and forward GEMM dimensions are identical.

If the proposed allocation helps rank35, delta35=AUC(output35)-AUC(raw35) will be positive; predeclare a consequential screen effect of at least0.0002. The rank-specific contrast is interaction=delta35-[AUC(output112)-AUC(full112)]. A positive interaction of at least0.0002 is preliminary support for rank-dependent optimization sensitivity; similar positive deltas instead suggest a general parameterization effect. Report exact deltas and negative interactions too. One seed cannot establish either mechanism.

Freeze this-round utility gate before host screening: output35 must reach click AUC at least0.6672485580556159 (historical current incumbent minus0.0002) AND no more than0.0002 below the contemporaneous balanced112 bridge. Preserve the original joint-entry comparison separately, with original entry AUC0.666753547526167 and DIN0.6555440824200336; do not relax an earlier gate based on new outcomes. A full112 output-heavy improvement may be a quality observation but cannot count as capacity reduction.

Efficiency requires host-measured full four-task inference wall time at least2% lower AND model batch p50 at least1% lower than contemporaneous balanced112, with p95 no worse and train_seconds no more than5% higher. Training exposure stays matched. Require repeated matched host timings before claiming measured cost reduction; retain total wall/allocated GPU seconds, examples, memory, throughput and p50/p95. If fewer Parameters alone improve, call it storage reduction only. No speed benefit is predicted from balance at fixed rank because its runtime graph is unchanged.

Report all four task AUC/Logloss and auxiliary mean separately, including the large inherited auxiliary gap against DIN. Report existing history slices with positive/negative counts (negative=samples-positive), marking empty/insufficient slices and any exploratory analyses. Do not fabricate absent hour/frequency/field slices or bootstrap intervals.

If a candidate passes screening, seek three paired training seeds through a future host-authorized repetition interface only; do not override the frozen seed in this proposal or module. Final preservation support requires paired user-cluster bootstrap lower bound for candidate-reference AUC above-0.0002 where host predictions/user clusters are available and consistent paired-seed results. Without those, label single-seed results preliminary and uncertainty unavailable. Freeze suite before any withheld assessment.
falsifiers: If same-rank initial products differ beyond declared FP32 tolerance, common state/RNG changes, gradients violate ownership, padding changes valid predictions or Parameters retain unintended full storage, reject the implementation before scientific interpretation; preserve failed costs.

If output35 gains less than0.0002 over raw35, this bounded implementation does not support consequential optimization rescue. A nonpositive interaction weakens a rank-specific explanation, even when a main balance effect appears.

If output35 fails either AUC preservation comparison, it is not a quality-preserving capacity reduction. A reproducible loss across paired seeds rejects its utility without proving every omitted singular direction necessary.

If either measured inference gate fails, or repetitions erase the cost gain, reject the efficiency claim even if AUC or parameter count improves. One faster validation wall or a lower analytic operation count is insufficient.

The balanced full112/raw35 bridges should reproduce their own historical click AUC within1e-6 under matching host inputs/source/protocol. Larger discrepancies block interpretation pending diagnosis, with no silent recipe change or automatic duplicate retry.

factor AdamW geometry, effective weight decay and global dense clipping can alter shared updates; this study does not separate those optimizer effects
single fixed training seed and validation selection history; deterministic bridge repeats are not independent replication

Original singular-direction truncation and initial product energy remain different across ranks, so a cross-rank difference alone is not pure representational rank evidence; same-rank balance controls leave those fixed.

Global dense-gradient clipping couples private heads to shared updates despite source detaches. Without authorized gradient/clipping diagnostics the experiment cannot distinguish shared-context signal quality from clipping-mediated changes.

SVD orientation in degenerate subspaces, floating-point accumulation and adaptive optimizer scale may cause differences even though products agree in real arithmetic. Check, quantify and retain these limitations.
The earlier whole-affine output-heavy null may recur. No result on the previous architecture or external method is assumed to transfer.
Repeated same-seed bridges establish reproducibility, not seed uncertainty; adaptive validation search can select a chance improvement. No heldout feedback is available or requested.
